Junior AI Engineer - Kestrel Labs (fictional), Islamabad (Hybrid)

About the role
Kestrel Labs builds AI assistants for logistics companies. As a Junior AI Engineer you will help build and ship LLM-powered features, from data preparation to production APIs.

Responsibilities
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over customer documents.
- Develop and maintain Python REST APIs (FastAPI) that serve model outputs.
- Write SQL to prepare evaluation datasets and analyze model performance.
- Evaluate LLM outputs and reduce hallucinations.
- Collaborate with the team through Git code reviews.

Requirements (must have)
- Strong Python programming skills
- Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals (overfitting, evaluation metrics)
- Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering or RAG
- Experience building REST APIs, ideally with FastAPI
- Working knowledge of SQL
- Git and collaborative development

Nice to have
- Docker and basic cloud deployment (AWS or GCP)
- Experience with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma)
- LangChain or LlamaIndex
- Good written and verbal communication

0-2 years of experience. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
